words.gloss: to grow thin and waste away

literal: Along with bracelets shoulders to grow thin I suffer; him cruel that calling feeling pained.
translation: I suffer as my shoulders waste away and my bracelets slip off; yet, it pains me even more to call him cruel.
modern: வளையல்களுடன் தோள்களும் மெலிந்து போவதால் நான் வருந்துகிறேன்; ஆனால், அதற்காக அவரை இரக்கமற்றவர் என்று சொல்வதற்கும் என் மனம் நொந்து தயங்குகிறது.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine expresses her deep conflict during separation. Her grief has caused her to lose so much weight that her shoulders have shrunk, causing her bracelets to slip off. While she suffers from this physical decline, she finds it even more painful to blame her lover and call him cruel for leaving her. Her love is so profound that she would rather bear the physical wasting of her body than speak ill of her beloved.
